claims.statement: For every finite simple graph G on m vertices, every W containing all isolated vertices of G, and every integer k>=2 with m<=2k+1, if q_j counts independent j-sets meeting W, then q_(k+1)<=q_k.
claims.scope: Arbitrary finite simple graphs; W contains every isolate; integer k>=2 and m<=2k+1. Generic marked counts; no tree, bipartite, selector, residual, or first-descent hypothesis.
claims.reason: retained — The incidence identity follows by counting addability pairs, with actual e(A)=m-k-|N_G(A)| and each multiply marked upper set counted once in C. For m<=2k the sign is immediate. At m=2k+1, good sets pay through B; bad sets are k-sets of isolates and inject into C by adjoining a fixed non-isolate. If no non-isolate exists, complementation gives equality. The k>=2 guard is exactly what ensures at least two marks in the injection image.

limitations: Informal proof audit only; no Lean formalization or kernel receipt.
The disposition covers only E993-MARKED-ISOLATE-ORDER-BAND at m<=2k+1 and does not transfer it to leaf-specific or lower-region aggregate claims.
